description: This file defines the DisplayField entity class for the OrangeHRM project, mapping to the 'ohrm_display_field' database table. It extends AbstractDisplayField and manages properties like id, className, and associated SelectedDisplayField entities, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping.

classes.name: DisplayField
classes.description: Entity class representing display fields in the system, with properties for id, className, and related selected display fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the display field.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the class name associated with this display field.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name for this display field.
